text: 香港证监会主席黄天祐出席香港证券业协会47周年金融创新论坛，并发表主题演说，指出金融业真正需要的，不只是“人工智能”Artificial Intelligence，而是Accountable Intelligence，也就是“问责智能”。
text_en: Huang Tianyou, Chairman of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission, attended the 47th anniversary Financial Innovation Forum of the Hong Kong Securities Association and delivered a keynote speech, pointing out that what the financial industry really needs is not just "Artificial Intelligence," but Accountable Intelligence.
